Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerkâ€™s office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speakerâ€™s card available at the end of each row in the Chambers. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

DRAFT MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA
  September 25, 2012

A regular meeting of the City Council of the City of Palos Verdes Estates was called to order
this day at 7:30 PM in the Council Chambers of City Hall by Mayor Bird.

7:38 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL (7:30 PM)

CEREMONIAL MATTERS

Police Chief Dan Dreiling delivered the oath of office to Police Chief John Eberhard.

Chief Dreiling pinned on his badge. Chief Eberhard said he was overwhelmed with the show of
support and thenked everyone. He said he was truly honored that City Mgr and Council has placed
confidence in him. Introduced his family; part of thsi community for 40+ years and conveyed how
much this means to him. Philisophy will not change and will stay engaged, DDP, PVE CARES,
and involved in Neighborhood Watch. Thanked everyone in department for support = will continue
to work as a team and thanked them for their support. Acknowledged members of PVE-CARES
volunteers who were present in support. Known Dan 30+ years and experiences; when 2004
adverse conditions, but stayed in the ring and made dept. what it is because of his leadership. Big
shoes to fill and reiterated his thanks to everyone where were present to show their support.

Council congratulated the new Chief. Fammily photograph. All members of PVEPD for photo
brought forward for group photo.

Mayor Bird called to attention. Ruth Gralow, former Mayor, spoke on behalf of PVE-CARES
volunteers for nearly 8 years with the group. What he Dan has done for PVE-CARES thanked him
for the concept. John, detail oriented and thanked on behalf of all the volunteers; everyone has
enjoyed this program.MPT Goodhart welcomed and congratulated new Chief; carry forward best

 interest of our residents and look forward to long tenure.

Councilmember Perkins congratulated Chief; heart warming to be here this evening to see that the
future of hte dpeartment is in wonderful hands = trust, confidence continuing the legacy serving
with creativity, intelligence.

Councilmber Humphrey added her congratulations 4thh Police Chief with whom she has worked
since becoming a Councilmember. Cant think of anyone better to take the helm; wished him mjuch
success.

Councilmember Rea John said big shoes to fill; he was chief of not only PD abut of our
community.

Mayor Bird men and women who serve and who volunteer with PVE cARES NW and other
community groups. Thanked for service and lok forward to his leadership.
